user_report: autofocus with artificial star off doesn't move focus at all (bundle reason field: 'Manual capture from UI (no note given)'). NOTE: the incident's autofocus record is the STALE earlier artificial-star run (start 14461, 18.575 ms exposure attempt) -- the terrestrial run was still in progress at capture (auto-exposure paused); the frames are what that terrestrial run measured.
optical_setup: Main optical train, ATR585M (mono, 16-bit, 3840x2160), 2.0 s exposure at dusk, OnStep focuser, terrestrial scene; the three Main frames are NOT committed (large data stays local): local_test_data/56-dusk/frames/frame_0..2.fits, lossless uint16, made by scripts/slim_regression_frames.py from the diagnostic bundle -- see README.md

cases.name: added_defocus_lowers_the_score
cases.rationale: Known software transform: the mean of the three real Main frames is blurred by an exact (FFT) Gaussian of sigma 0/2/4/8/16/32 px -- strictly more defocus at every step -- and each level gets three fresh samples of the bundle's own measured sensor noise (sigma = std(frame_1 - frame_0)/sqrt(2) ~ 829 ADU, by hand). More defocus must give a strictly lower score, by at least 5 % per coarse step from 4 px on (issue #56 AC). Before the fix the score was non-monotone (coordinator measurement: 0 px 2.28e7, 4 px 1.83e7, 8 px 1.83e7, 32 px 2.24e7), so the search saw no 5 % improvement either way and returned to the start. Exercised by tests/regressions/test_issue_56_terrestrial_autofocus_regression.py.

cases.name: noise_alone_marks_no_tile_as_moving
cases.rationale: By construction: three frames of a constant (the real frame's median) plus independent Gaussian noise at the bundle's own measured sigma have no moving content, so no tile may be rejected as moving (before the fix: 1839 of 1980 tiles were rejected on these real frames).

cases.name: replaced_tile_is_rejected_as_moving
cases.rationale: By construction: the 64x64 px sky tile at rows/cols 128..191 (one production tile) is replaced in samples 1 and 2 by uniform random content of 5000..60000 ADU, so exactly one more tile than on the unmodified frames must be rejected as moving.

cases.name: score_independent_of_the_sample_set
cases.rationale: By construction: all three samples were taken at ONE focuser position, so every ordering, every subset and every duplicated re-read of them measures the same focus and must give the same score within the search's own 5 % improvement margin (BoundedFocusSearcher improvement_fraction = 0.05) -- otherwise sample noise alone can look like a focus step (issue #56 review F1: 27-58 % spread before).

cases.name: clipped_highlights_step_down
cases.rationale: Known software transform with a known optimum: the frames' clipped glints are set to K x full scale (K = 1, 3), the scene is defocused by a Gaussian of sigma = |position - 2500| / 50 px BEFORE clipping, scaled by the exposure and re-clipped; best focus is 2500 by construction. Driven through the real AutofocusController and BoundedFocusSearcher from 2500 +- 500, the run must step the exposure down and land within one coarse step (250) of 2500; with K = 10 (still clipping at the lowest exposure tried) or without exposure control it must report highlights_clipped, never SUCCESS (issue #56 review F3, contract amendment).
